agent_direct_requested_resources.authority_registry_resolution: exact operation name+version row from proof.dev/authority-operation-registry/v1
agent_direct_requested_resources.array_rule: copy every accepted AuthorizationDecisionV2 requested_resources array exactly after its required canonical ordering and uniqueness checks; workspace_ids is the singleton command Workspace; no field may be dropped, added, coarsened, or reinterpreted

binding_preimage.rule: name equals registry binding_name; value is the exact typed public-safe projection; null only for declared nullable value_type

requested_resources_preimage.bindings: UTF-8 name-sorted exact {name,value_digest} array; value_digest is the binding digest above; no raw private OIDC issuer, subject, blind, token, or provider diagnostic

typed_limit_semantics.aggregate_measure: sum-array-lengths adds the array lengths at schema_path and additional_schema_path; a missing optional array contributes zero
